description: Master Pipeline Registry — canonical pipeline universe for Luminari. Each entry defines a distinct case domain with category assignment, default lenses, and alias mappings. This registry is the authoritative classification layer referenced by the pipeline resolver, lens engine, intake system, pattern detection, and narrative context.

justice.label: Justice & Accountability
justice.description: Cases involving law enforcement misconduct, prosecutorial or judicial failures, wrongful convictions, civil rights violations, and government accountability.

family.label: Family Law
family.description: Cases involving domestic violence, custody, child welfare, guardianship, foster care, juvenile proceedings, and family court matters.

elder.label: Elder & Disability
elder.description: Cases involving elder abuse, nursing home neglect, disability rights, guardianship abuse, and vulnerable adult protection.

tribal.label: Tribal & Indigenous
tribal.description: Cases involving tribal law, sovereignty, treaty rights, ICWA compliance, MMIW, and tribal governance disputes.

insurance.label: Insurance & Medical
insurance.description: Cases involving insurance claim denials, medical malpractice, health coverage disputes, billing abuse, and medical device injuries.

housing.label: Housing & Property
housing.description: Cases involving tenant rights, eviction, habitability, housing discrimination, foreclosure, and property disputes.

financial.label: Financial & Consumer
financial.description: Cases involving debt collection abuse, predatory lending, consumer fraud, identity theft, securities fraud, and financial exploitation.

employment.label: Employment & Labor
employment.description: Cases involving workplace discrimination, wrongful termination, wage theft, labor violations, and worker misclassification.

benefits.label: Benefits & Public Assistance
benefits.description: Cases involving denial of SNAP, veterans benefits, Social Security disability, Medicaid, unemployment, and public assistance disputes.

market.label: Market & Corporate
market.description: Cases involving antitrust violations, corporate capture, supply chain exploitation, regulatory capture, and algorithmic discrimination.

environment.label: Environmental & Public Health
environment.description: Cases involving environmental violations, water contamination, toxic exposure, air quality, and community health risks.

immigration.label: Immigration
immigration.description: Cases involving immigration proceedings, asylum claims, detention conditions, family separation, and work authorization disputes.

public_safety.label: Public Safety & Emergency
public_safety.description: Cases involving immediate threats, emergency safety situations, human trafficking, missing persons, and disaster relief.

general.label: General Investigation
general.description: Cases that do not fit a specific domain category, cross-border jurisdictional disputes, multi-party actions, and personal investigations.

mental_health.label: Mental Health System
mental_health.description: Cases involving involuntary psychiatric holds, polypharmacy harm, discharge failures, family exclusion from care decisions, restraint and seclusion incidents, and medical record correction. For people who entered the mental health system seeking help and need their experience documented, their voice restored, and accountability established.

Cases involving involuntary psychiatric holds (5150, Baker Act, emergency petitions), commitment hearings, and legal basis challenges. For people who were placed on a hold and never understood why or whether it was legal.

Cases involving family members excluded from care decisions, denied information, denied visitation, or left without tools or rights while watching a loved one disappear into the system. For families who had no roadmap.
